message: <ng-container> bind(s) [attr.aria-label] or [attr.aria-labelledby] to the inputs on Angular's own tag
$reason: The reference's triggers and panel, each carrying the consumer's name, and the name handed as well to a directive on an `<ng-container>`. Bound on a container, `[ariaLabel]` and `[ariaLabelledby]` compile only where a directive takes them as inputs (NG8002, measured with `ngc` 22.2.1), and the container draws a comment, so the name reaches no element of its own and goes where no point follows. Asked whether its role takes a name, the tag was one axe does not know and spares, as it spares a custom element, and the template passed: the last reading of a container as an element.
